notes: The catalog text does not contain the Information Processing Specialist Certificate of Achievement section. It begins mid-description of the A.S. in Information Processing, whose description says the Information Processing Technician and Information Processing Specialist certificates serve as major fields of study for that degree.

The A.S. in Information Processing requirements (CISA 305, 306, 315, 316, 323, 340; CISC 305, 310, 320; CISC 351 or CISN 340; CISC 360; CISS 300 or CISS 310; Total Units: 23 - 27.5) closely match the closed list. CISW 306 is the exception: it appears only in the A.S. Web Developer section.

These degree requirements were not recorded as the certificate's, because they belong to a different award and may differ from it. The certificate likely includes CISW 306. A reviewer should fetch the certificate's own section, likely on an adjacent page (around page 264), and complete the record.

Outcomes and careers printed in the A.S. Information Processing section were not recorded, because they are not printed for this certificate in the supplied text. The careers named there are office supervisors, office managers, computer support specialists and information processing specialists.
